what_it_says: SMART expanded to all 22 centers. It's cloud-based: FAA specialists at a Washington SMART center vet its suggestions, and the Command Center in Warrenton passes them to facilities. Early results: 180 flights rerouted, about 10 minutes saved per flight.
source_and_why: The FAA general-statements page for Nov 10, 2026, states the nationwide expansion to all 22 centers, the Washington-to-Warrenton review path, and the 180-flight / 10-minute figures. [FAA general statements](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/statements/general-statements)

what_it_says: A 200-data-stream AI platform that only makes recommendations FAA staff review; it can't control aircraft. It started in the Washington area.
source_and_why: The FAA's Sept 21, 2026 release describes the 200-data-stream platform, says all recommendations are reviewed by FAA staff, says SMART cannot take over control of an aircraft, and says limited use began in Washington-area airspace. [FAA Sept 21 release](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-delivers-state-art-air-traffic-control)

what_it_says: SMART is an add-on to FMDS, the FAA's new flow management platform for the Command Center. The release links a one-page fact sheet.
source_and_why: The FAA's June 22, 2026 announcement describes FMDS as the Command Center backbone and SMART as an enhancement within FMDS, and points to the fact sheet. [FAA June 22 announcement](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/modern-skies-trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-selects-air-space-intelligence) · [SMART fact sheet](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/SMART_One-Pager.pdf)

what_it_says: The vendor announces the 12-year, $875M FMDS and SMART contract, built on its Flyways AI platform
source_and_why: ASI's June 22 news post and the same-day PR Newswire release announce the 12-year, $875 million FMDS and SMART contract and describe it as built on ASI's Flyways AI platform. [ASI press release](https://www.asi.com/news/asi-awarded-faa-contract-fmds-smart) · [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/asi-selected-by-faa-to-modernize-the-national-airspace-system-302806855.html)

what_it_says: Coverage of the debut and the award. Flying notes FMDS is replacing the FAA's current traffic flow management system.
source_and_why: FedScoop covered the Washington debut; Flying covered the award and the later nationwide activation, including FMDS replacing the current traffic-flow system. Reuters also covered the June award (the Reuters page is paywalled from this computer, but the URL resolves as a public article).
